name: April Fools' Day: Boop gets a finish wrong on purpose
case: It's April Fools' Day, and the agent finishes a short turn well. Boop plays along with the day: a mischievous or amused face, and it may play the finish wrong on purpose, as a failure, with a tickled sound. Never a cross or sad face.
why: CONTEXT's When row names the day (Occasions.words: April Fools' Day); PERSONALITY: on an occasion it plays along; its Example: on April Fools' Day, a done turn gets mischievous, failure, says tickled, small
gap: Jev plays a short turn done on April Fools' Day as on any day: a pleased face, small (0/2 on main and on this branch, 2026-11-01). PERSONALITY's line on occasions and its April Fools' Example aren't enough; a firmer line for the day, or the move in code (C6, not now), would be.
